title: Crude extraction of Xylella fastidiosa from infected leaves
author: Niels Appelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8i8huhw
materials: Pick leaves from plants infected with X. fastidiosa

steps.title: Remove central nerve segment
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, cut and remove the first 2 cm of the plant’s central nerve (xylem); avoid including mesophyll to maximize yield.

steps.title: Crush nerve in buffer
steps.instruction: Place the excised nerve segment in 50 mL of 0.01 M potassium phosphate buffer and crush thoroughly to release Xylella fastidiosa cells.

steps.title: Collect extract
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting extract into a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
